description:
Inspect Assistant

Read your chats with Vruum. Read-only.

- list: no id; optional payload={before_updated_at, before_id, limit}.
  Your chats in this workspace, newest first. For the next page pass the
  last item's updated_at and id.
- read: id=chat UUID; optional payload={before_sequence, limit}. The
  chat's messages with full text (newest page first), its turns with
  their state, and its record changes (items) with their Undo state and
  each answer's current rating. Use next_before_sequence for earlier
  messages.

A turn in state running is still working; read again for its answer.
Messages, changes and ratings are the same ones the app's chat panel
shows.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

Chat with Vruum support (assistant_conversations):
Product support is not permission. Inspect current work and follow the domain's authorization and review rules.
- start_conversation: manage_assistant action=start_conversation. Start a chat with one message and wait up to 50 s for the answer. The same request UUID reaches the same chat and turn on a retry.
- append_message: manage_assistant action=append_message. Send the next message in a chat and wait the same way. One message runs at a time per chat.
- undo: manage_assistant action=undo. Undo one record change the chat applied, by its item ID. Refused when the record was edited since.
- decide_card: manage_assistant action=decide_card. Decide one pending card by its item ID: approved runs its exact call once under the caller's credentials; declined never runs it.
- rate: manage_assistant action=rate. Rate one answer up or down with optional reasons; 0 clears it.
- list: inspect_assistant action=list. Page the current member's chats in the workspace, newest first.
- read: inspect_assistant action=read. Read a chat's messages with full text, its turns, its record changes and the reader's ratings. Follow next_before_sequence.
- sharing: unsupported. No shared participants: a chat is readable only by its author.

action.description: The operation to perform — see the tool description for the action vocabulary and each action's id/payload semantics.
action.title: action

for_company.description: Optional company ID or name (UUID, or case-insensitive EXACT name match — partial / substring matches are NOT supported; ambiguous names raise 400) to execute this tool as. Use get_operator_companies, or get_operator_overview with view='companies', to list available companies. Only needed if you manage multiple companies. Access is enforced server-side: the tool resolves the value to a user_company_id and verifies the caller's membership in `company_users` — a 403 'Company not found or access denied' means EITHER the value did not match a known company OR the caller is not a member of it. The MCP operator role itself is NOT auto-granted — operators get this access by being members of each client company via `company_users` (the same row that grants any normal user access).
for_company.title: for_company

id.description: Target entity id, or an ARRAY of ids to apply the same action+payload to each (max 100; see the tool description for which entity the id names per action).
id.title: id

items.description: For create-like actions only: an array of per-item payloads processed in order with per-item results (max 100). Mutually exclusive with `id` and `payload`.
items.title: items

payload.description: Action-specific fields, validated by the underlying route's own schema (a bad field 422s with that route's precise errors). See the tool description per action.
payload.title: payload
